# Sparse-MDS documentation bundle

All attempted-fit records, failures, scores, timings and metadata are retained.
Seed-1 coordinates support the fixed guide views; evaluation source identities
and modes are included. Full coordinates for other starts and evaluation target
matrices are in the source checkout at
`tools/pkg/fixtures/documentation-data/sparse-mds-comparison/benchmark.rds`.
No fits or scores were recalculated when deriving this compact bundle.
